messages:
maria: rolling out smart-burst + proxy-quant profile to prod canary now (10%). goal: lower p50 at high concurrency and cut token compute cost. will post numbers after first hour. :rocket:
infra-bot: deployed runtime-proxy v3.4.1-canary tag=proxy-quant-smartburst canary=10%
alex: nice — what benchmark workload?
maria: using chat_short (median 32t) + assistant_long (median 180t) with last-week traffic shape. baseline v3.3.8.
ben: any quality evals? quant can nudge logits.
maria: ran 5k evals across top-3 models. quality delta ~0.2% on our internal metric, under alert. eval gist: https://internal.gist/redwood/qp-eval-214432
jess: rollback plan? alerts?
maria: rollback steps (manual):
1) pause canary: infractl canary pause --service runtime-proxy --tag proxy-quant-smartburst
2) deploy old: infractl deploy --service runtime-proxy --tag v3.3.8 --scale 20%
3) open incident channel + page @oncall
Alerting: p95 >= baseline*1.15 or quality_regress >= 1.0% triggers pause + page.
sam_k: wiring dashboard: p50/p95/p99, cost_per_token, regen_quality_score; will post link in 10m.
infra-bot: canary progress: 10% -> 50% at 2144322800 (auto-ramp).
maria: first hour (50%): p50 -12% (82ms->72ms), p95 -9% (210ms->191ms), token compute cost -18% (~$0.27->$0.22 per 1M tokens).
alex: solid. p99?
maria: p99 ~ +1% (no meaningful regression). proxy batching avoids spikes.
ben: KV-cache heavy sessions?
maria: included KV-heavy synthetic load. small increase in evictions; added micro-evict throttle.
jess: proceed to full rollout if no alerts in 3h. make post-rollout note for CS & docs.
maria: will auto-ramp to 100% over 1h starting in 15m if green. ping here for status. :eyes:
infra-bot: canary progress: 50% -> 100% at 2144324400. rollout complete. :white_check_mark:
maria: TL;DR — proxy-quant + smart-burst rolled out. p50 ~-12%, p95 ~-9%, token compute cost ~-18%. no quality regressions. thanks runtime & infra teams.
sam_k: monitoring looks good; 24h watch then handoff to oncall.
ben: note for docs: update quantization tuning guide. cc @docs.
alex: awesome work all. :tada:
